summary: Iteration 9: Tested Client Onboarding workflow end-to-end. Backend POST /api/onboarding correctly creates client + tasks + engagements + document checklist; staff role gets 403; duplicate names return 400; high-risk and VAT services correctly extend the document checklist. GET /api/onboarding/document-checklist preview matches services & risk. Frontend multi-step wizard works for partner Arjun: stepper, validation gates (name required on step 1, >=1 service on step 2), service toggle, prev/next nav, submit produces success view with task/engagement/document counts. Staff Fazil correctly sees Access Restricted on /onboarding and the sidebar item is hidden. All 7 backend pytest cases and all 14 Playwright UI checkpoints passed.

issues: React hydration warning logged in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The Emergent dev tracking wrapper injects a <span> inside <option> for the dynamic staff list. Functionality is unaffected, but the console error appears on every step-4 render. Consider rendering option label as plain string children only (already a string) — the wrapper is auto-injected at build, so it may need a build-config or plain-text marker; otherwise this is benign noise.

action_items: Optional: investigate React 'span cannot be child of option' hydration warning in ClientOnboarding.js step-4 staff dropdown (cosmetic console error only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2140 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth, clients, tasks, engagements, onboarding, exports). Already flagged in earlier iterations; growing.
Onboarding endpoint correctly excludes Mongo _id from all returned docs (uses {_id: 0} or builds new dict).
RBAC check (role=='partner') is enforced on POST /onboarding — good. GET /onboarding/document-checklist intentionally does not gate by role (any authenticated user can preview); acceptable.
Duplicate detection only matches exact name (case-sensitive). Consider case-insensitive match to prevent 'Acme LLC' vs 'acme llc' duplicates.

Onboarding is not transactional: if engagement insert fails after client + tasks already inserted, partial state remains. Acceptable for MVP, but worth noting for future hardening (e.g., wrap in a session/transaction or implement compensation).
